headline: Kenyan Bank NCBA Reports 14.5% Profit Rise on Lending Growth
summary: Kenya's NCBA Group posted a nine-month profit of approximately US$145 million, up 14.5%, driven by loan growth and disciplined cost management.
why: Commercial bank earnings reports reflect domestic credit expansion, interest rate spreads, and financial sector health in East African economies.

impacts.name: NCBA Group
impacts.why: Higher net profit and lending growth reflect positive commercial banking performance.
